description: Binds each benchmark configuration ID to the one embedding model its index was built with. An index is only valid for the encoder that produced it; loading it with a different encoder of the same dimension fails silently rather than raising, so the pairing is recorded here and checked at load time by src/embedding/registry.py.

c001.provenance_note: No build manifest exists for this index; it predates scripts/index_documents.py writing one. Embedding model, revision and dimension come from benchmarking/runs/baseline_context8k/local_retrieval_verification.json (15 September 2026 check), which reproduced the saved retrieval. Hashes were verified against this directory on 18 September 2026. Historical encoder runtime and server hardware remain unknown.

c002.provenance_note: Built 17 September 2026 by scripts/index_documents.py, which wrote manifest.json in this directory. The manifest's own sha256 differs between machines because it was committed from Windows with CRLF normalisation; see models/README.md.

c003.provenance_note: Built 18 September 2026 from the same frozen extraction snapshot as c001/c002 (data/extracted_v1), so chunking is the only factor that differs from c001. Only the 176 child chunks are embedded; the 51 parents are held out and substituted at retrieval time by ParentAwareRetriever. The build is deterministic: rebuilding from the same chunks.jsonl reproduced all three artifact hashes exactly. manifest.json is deliberately absent from the files checked by the registry audit because it carries a build timestamp.
